Every length to scale within its panel and measured from the sources named; the slot on the die is an example.

g.aria-label: The QFN-64 package, 9.00 mm square, with the 3.588 by 5.188 mm die drawn inside it.
g.text: 64 pins at a 0.5 mm pitch. Dashed: the 7.65 mm exposed pad underneath.
Where the die sits inside the package is not published, so it is drawn centred.
